title: Flutter Neumorphic
lede: A Flutter UI kit from February 2020 that turned the two-shadow recipe into depth, intensity, and light-source settings.
summary: Idean’s open-source neumorphic widget kit for Flutter, with a playground for depth, intensity, and shape.
made: 2020–2021 (version 0.0.1 on 19 February 2020; version 3.2.0 on 11 November 2021, per pub.dev)

evidence.note: Inspected frames of the repository’s own `medias/playground.gif` (500 × 842). The stored image is its first frame. The showcase image `medias/showcase_1.png` was also viewed; it contains a third-party photograph and is not stored. Licence read through the GitHub API; dates from the pub.dev API.

styles.note: The kit is built for the style: every widget shares the surface color and gets a light and a dark shadow set by a depth value, positive to rise and negative to sink.

context: The README calls it “a complete, ready to use, Neumorphic ui kit for Flutter”. The repository was created on 19 February 2020, about ten weeks after [Malewicz named the style](ref:malewicz-neumorphism-article-2019).
Its style settings are named depth, intensity, surface intensity, light source, and shape (concave, convex, flat, emboss).
Released under the Apache License 2.0. It had about 2,200 GitHub stars on 2026-09-28, the most of any repository returned by a GitHub search for “neumorphic”.
observed: A rounded square in the center of a pale gray surface, the same color as the surface. A white glow sits to its upper left and a gray shadow to its lower right.
Two blue sliders at the top and left edges set the light direction.
A lower panel with “Style” and “Element” tabs and sliders for Depth (11), Intensity (0.86), and SurfaceIntensity (0.5). The tabs and panel are flat white and saturated blue, not neumorphic.
interpretation: The playground makes the grammar of the style explicit as parameters: one surface color, a light source, and a depth that sets the offset and blur of both shadows. The Material-style control panel below it shows how often the style was confined to a few hero elements.
borrow: Expose depth as one signed number, positive for raised and negative for pressed, and derive both shadows from it.
